thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — consolidating action items for rollout safety. I'll list owners + short targets, please ack and call dibs.

maria: Thanks Alex. Can we explicitly call out the recurring pattern? I counted 3 similar incidents in the last 90 days.

alex: Yep. Observed pattern: feature flag -> gradual canary -> downstream DB throttling -> latency/errors. Root cause: rollout concurrency + no auto-rollback + insufficient blast-radius controls. Proposed remediation items: auto-rollback policy, per-flag blast-radius caps, rollout templates with shard-level concurrency limits, and canary sampling fixes.

devon: I'll own auto-rollback implementation and alert wiring. Target: 2 weeks (2025-03-10). Plan: add rule + unit/integration harness simulating error injection.

maria: I'll own blast-radius caps and product thresholds. Need product sign-off for per-customer caps and opt-out. Target: 3 weeks (2025-03-17).

sam: I'll take rollout template sharding + telemetry changes, and fix the sampling bias. Target: 10 days (2025-03-05).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started 2025-02-21T03:12Z — canary: shard=3, concurrency=180, sample=0.05

alex: Example of current flag config we hit during the incident:
```
flag_config: {
  "staged": true,
  "shards": 10,
  "concurrency_limit": 180,
  "sample_rate": 0.05
}
```
Proposal: default concurrency_limit = 20 for new rollouts; require explicit risk sign-off to raise. Also add an emergency auto-rollback rule: if 5xx_rate > 1% OR p95 latency > 2s sustained for 2m -> rollback to previous version.

maria: That rollback trigger sounds reasonable. For blast-radius cap, proposal: per-flag max active users + per-shard cap + hard global throttle. Will write design doc.

alex: Operational tracking — we need a single source of truth for follow-ups. I'm creating a GH project board "rollout-safety" and a recurring weekly triage issue. All remediation items get a ticket with label `rollout-safety`.

devon: I'll open PR #1487 that wires the alert -> rollback action and adds tests. Open items: safe fallback ordering (scale down vs rollback), and integration test that simulates DB saturation.

sam: Note: we observed canary sampling bias due to sticky routing on edge. I'll randomize bucket hashing in the routing layer and add sampling verification metrics.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with Product on customer-impact thresholds and opt-out behavior (we need legal review for some customers).

alex: Timeline recap: auto-rollback PR by 2025-03-10 (devon), sharding + sampling fixes by 2025-03-05 (sam), blast-radius cap design by 2025-03-17 (maria). Weekly triage scheduled Friday 10am PT. @devon @maria @sam add blockers to the board.

devon: Adding initial PR and will post links to tests.

ops-bot: tracker-bot: created issue ROLL-SAFE-472 and scheduled recurring weekly triage.

alex: Thanks — if no objections I'll mark these as action items on the postmortem and close the thread.

maria: No objections.

devon: None from me.

sam: All good.

alex: Closing — I'll post board link once it's set up and ping before the first triage.
